newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Rates falls for 52-week Tunisian treasury bill.
newsitem.headline: Rates falls for 52-week Tunisian treasury bill.

text.p: The Tunisian Treasury raised five million dinars at its weekly auction of treasury bills dated Tuesday February 18, and repaid maturing paper totalling 38.5 million dinars.
The issue was at a 7.0625 percent coupon rate for 52-week bills, down from 7.8750 percent on January 7, when the 52-week maturity was last sold.

The Treasury said bidders demand amounted to a total 406 million dinars for 13-, 26-, 52-week and two-year paper at between 7.0000 and 7.5000 percent. The Treasury didnt issue such maturities this week. ($=1.07 dinar)
